# arianet_image (Data Source)

One image, looked up in `GET /cloud/v1/images` by `id`, `image` (slug/reference), `name` or `label_selector`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_image" "ubuntu" {
  name       = "Ubuntu 24.04"
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
}

data "arianet_image" "latest_snapshot" {
  type           = "snapshot"
  label_selector = "app=web"
  most_recent    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `datacenter` (String) Restrict to images available in this datacenter.
- `id` (String) Image ID.
- `image` (String) Image slug or reference, as `arianet_server.image` takes it.
- `label_selector` (String) Restrict to images matching this label selector.
- `most_recent` (Boolean) When several images match, take the newest instead of failing.
- `name` (String) Image name.
- `type` (String) Restrict to `system`, `app`, `snapshot` or `backup`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (snapshots/backups).
- `datacenters` (List of String) Datacenters that have the image.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the image is deprecated.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Smallest root disk the image fits on.
- `project_id` (Number) Project (snapshots/backups).
- `status` (String) Status.
